prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production decorative asset for an Adventy daily-task reading card in the same hand-painted winter storybook world as the supplied house reference. Soft amber lamplight from the house, rich hand-painted wood-and-paper textures, carefully observed materials, blue winter reflected shadows. Composition: all objects form one natural small arrangement toward right half, left half mostly EMPTY and transparent so real live date text can sit beside it; edges softly feather naturally into alpha, no hard rectangular picture border. Landscape ratio about 3:1, transparent background. No lettering, numbers, watermark, emblems, wax seals, hearts, stars, emoji, cartoon stickers or icon-like outlines. This is an elegant illustrated winter letter detail matching the provided richly illustrated house, restrained enough for a readable task card, not a photographic mockup or whole UI.
